DHA meta-analysis — data check

Author

Dave Bridges

Purpose

This document checks every study’s data before the Lipg / Mfsd2a vs milk-DHA analysis. It reads data/studies_manifest.csv, tests each study’s RNA and lipid files, and reports each check as PASS / WARN / FAIL / MISSING. It ends with a to-do list of what is still needed. Re-render it each time new data arrive.

Analysis it feeds.

  • Human arm (IMAGE-GDM): log milk DHA ~ gene + log plasma DHA + GDM.
  • Mouse arm: mouse studies with paired animals pooled, log DHA% ~ gene + study.
  • Contrast level: every study, including those where RNA and milk come from different animals (linkage = group, e.g. OXTR): DHA log ratio vs gene log fold change.
  • Genes: Lipg, Mfsd2a (primary); Btn1a1 (total-fat positive control).

Data format

Manifest (data/studies_manifest.csv). One row per study.

Column Meaning
study short study name
species mouse or human
sample_type bulk_tissue, snRNA_pseudobulk or milk_cells
lipid_method GCMS or lipidomics
sequenced TRUE / FALSE (NA if unknown)
linkage individual (RNA and lipids from the same animals) or group (different animals; group-level contrast only)
rna_path count matrix: genes in rows (first column = gene symbol), samples in columns; .csv, .tsv or .rds
lipid_path lipid table, one row per individual (see below)
id_key_path optional; two columns rna_id, lipid_id, when the RNA and lipid IDs differ
rna_samples_path group linkage only; two columns rna_id, group, with the same group labels as the lipid table
has_plasma TRUE if plasma fatty acids exist for this study

Lipid table (template: data/templates/lipids_template.csv). One row per individual.

Column Required? Notes
sample_id yes matches the RNA column names, or the lipid_id in the key
group yes arm, e.g. WT / KO, control / GDM
dha_molpct yes* DHA as mol% of total FA. *Or give dha_abs + total_fa_abs and it is calculated
total_fat recommended total fat or TG
lactation_day recommended
ara_molpct, epa_molpct, la_molpct, oleate_molpct, palmitate_molpct recommended for the specificity analysis
pc_dha lipidomics studies
plasma_dha_molpct studies with plasma
plasma_milk_days_apart studies with plasma days between plasma and milk collection
bmi, glucose, parity human

Setup

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

manifest_path <- "data/studies_manifest.csv"
out_dir       <- "output"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

gene_panel <- tribble(
  ~role,     ~mouse,   ~human,
  "primary", "Lipg",   "LIPG",
  "primary", "Mfsd2a", "MFSD2A",
  "control", "Btn1a1", "BTN1A1"
)

# Epithelial markers: bulk tissue needs these to estimate the epithelial fraction
epi_markers <- tribble(
  ~mouse,  ~human,
  "Krt8",  "KRT8",
  "Krt18", "KRT18",
  "Epcam", "EPCAM",
  "Csn2",  "CSN2"
)

thr <- list(
  min_paired_per_group = 3,      # paired RNA + lipid individuals per arm
  min_lib_bulk         = 5e6,    # minimum library size, bulk tissue
  min_lib_other        = 1e5,    # minimum library size, pseudobulk / milk cells
  gene_min_count       = 10,     # counts for a gene to be "measurable" in a sample
  gene_min_frac        = 0.5,    # fraction of samples that must reach gene_min_count
  outlier_mad          = 3,      # MADs from the median to flag an outlier
  # plausible milk DHA mol%; LC-MS lipidomics runs higher than GC-MS FAME
  # because medium-chain TGs are under-captured
  dha_range            = list(GCMS = c(0.01, 5), lipidomics = c(0.01, 15))
)

fa_cols <- c("dha_molpct", "ara_molpct", "epa_molpct", "la_molpct",
             "oleate_molpct", "palmitate_molpct")

manifest <- read_csv(manifest_path, show_col_types = FALSE,
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) |>
  mutate(across(c(sequenced, has_plasma), as.logical))
manifest

Helpers

# One row of the checklist
chk <- function(study, area, check, status, detail = "") {
  tibble(study = study, area = area, check = check,
         status = status, detail = detail)
}

file_ok <- function(p) !is.na(p) && nzchar(p) && file.exists(p)

read_counts <- function(path) {
  if (grepl("\\.rds$", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    m <- readRDS(path)
  } else {
    delim <- if (grepl("\\.(tsv|txt)(\\.gz)?$", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) "\t" else ","
    df <- read_delim(path, delim = delim, show_col_types = FALSE)
    m  <- as.matrix(df[, -1])
    rownames(m) <- df[[1]]
  }
  as.matrix(m)
}

# Flag values more than k MADs from the median (on the scale given)
mad_outlier <- function(x, k = thr$outlier_mad) {
  med <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  s   <- mad(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(s) || s == 0) return(rep(FALSE, length(x)))
  abs(x - med) / s > k
}

status_levels <- c("FAIL", "MISSING", "WARN", "PASS", "INFO", "SKIP")

RNA checks

check_rna <- function(st) {
  s <- st$study
  if (isFALSE(st$sequenced))
    return(list(checks = chk(s, "RNA", "RNA available", "SKIP", "not sequenced (validation cohort; qPCR later)"),
                counts = NULL))
  if (!file_ok(st$rna_path))
    return(list(checks = chk(s, "RNA", "RNA available", "MISSING",
                             if (is.na(st$rna_path)) "no rna_path in manifest"
                             else paste("file not found:", st$rna_path)),
                counts = NULL))

  m   <- read_counts(st$rna_path)
  out <- list(chk(s, "RNA", "RNA available", "PASS",
                  sprintf("%d genes x %d samples", nrow(m), ncol(m))))

  # Gene identifiers
  ens <- mean(grepl("^ENS(MUS)?G\\d+", rownames(m)))
  out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "RNA", "gene symbols",
                         if (ens > 0.5) "FAIL" else "PASS",
                         if (ens > 0.5) "rows look like Ensembl IDs; convert to symbols" else "")))
  dup <- sum(duplicated(rownames(m)))
  if (dup > 0) {
    out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "RNA", "duplicate genes", "WARN",
                           sprintf("%d duplicated symbols; summed", dup))))
    m <- rowsum(m, rownames(m))
  }

  # Raw counts?
  int <- all(abs(m - round(m)) < 1e-8, na.rm = TRUE)
  out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "RNA", "raw integer counts",
                         if (int) "PASS" else "WARN",
                         if (int) "" else "non-integer values; raw counts preferred")))

  # Library sizes
  lib     <- colSums(m, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_lib <- if (st$sample_type == "bulk_tissue") thr$min_lib_bulk else thr$min_lib_other
  low     <- names(lib)[lib < min_lib]
  outl    <- names(lib)[mad_outlier(log10(lib))]
  out <- c(out, list(
    chk(s, "RNA", "library size",
        if (length(low)) "WARN" else "PASS",
        sprintf("range %s-%s%s", format(min(lib), big.mark = ","),
                format(max(lib), big.mark = ","),
                if (length(low)) paste0("; below ", format(min_lib, big.mark = ","),
                                        ": ", paste(low, collapse = ", ")) else "")),
    chk(s, "RNA", "library-size outliers",
        if (length(outl)) "WARN" else "PASS",
        paste(outl, collapse = ", "))
  ))

  # Panel genes
  sp  <- st$species
  cpm <- t(t(m) / lib) * 1e6
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(gene_panel))) {
    g <- gene_panel[[sp]][i]
    if (!g %in% rownames(m)) {
      out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "Genes", g,
                             if (gene_panel$role[i] == "primary") "FAIL" else "WARN",
                             "not in count matrix")))
      next
    }
    frac <- mean(m[g, ] >= thr$gene_min_count)
    out <- c(out, list(chk(
      s, "Genes", g,
      if (frac >= thr$gene_min_frac) "PASS" else "WARN",
      sprintf("median CPM %.1f; counts %d-%d; %.0f%% of samples >= %d counts",
              median(cpm[g, ]), as.integer(min(m[g, ])), as.integer(max(m[g, ])),
              100 * frac, thr$gene_min_count))))
  }

  # Epithelial markers (needed to adjust bulk tissue for composition)
  if (st$sample_type == "bulk_tissue") {
    mk <- epi_markers[[sp]]
    n_mk <- sum(mk %in% rownames(m))
    out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "RNA", "epithelial markers",
                           if (n_mk >= 3) "PASS" else "WARN",
                           sprintf("%d of %d present (%s)", n_mk, length(mk),
                                   paste(mk, collapse = ", ")))))
  }

  list(checks = bind_rows(out), counts = m)
}

Lipid checks

check_lipids <- function(st) {
  s <- st$study
  if (!file_ok(st$lipid_path))
    return(list(checks = chk(s, "Lipids", "lipid table available", "MISSING",
                             if (is.na(st$lipid_path)) "no lipid_path in manifest"
                             else paste("file not found:", st$lipid_path)),
                lipids = NULL))

  d   <- read_csv(st$lipid_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  out <- list(chk(s, "Lipids", "lipid table available", "PASS",
                  sprintf("%d rows", nrow(d))))

  # Required identifiers
  miss_id <- setdiff(c("sample_id", "group"), names(d))
  if (length(miss_id))
    return(list(checks = bind_rows(c(out, list(
      chk(s, "Lipids", "required columns", "FAIL",
          paste("missing:", paste(miss_id, collapse = ", ")))))),
      lipids = NULL))
  d <- d |> mutate(sample_id = as.character(sample_id))

  dup <- d$sample_id[duplicated(d$sample_id)]
  out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "Lipids", "unique sample IDs",
                         if (length(dup)) "FAIL" else "PASS",
                         paste(unique(dup), collapse = ", "))))

  # DHA: use mol% if given, otherwise calculate it
  if (!"dha_molpct" %in% names(d) && all(c("dha_abs", "total_fa_abs") %in% names(d))) {
    d <- d |> mutate(dha_molpct = 100 * dha_abs / total_fa_abs)
    out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "Lipids", "DHA mol%", "INFO",
                           "calculated from dha_abs / total_fa_abs")))
  }
  if (!"dha_molpct" %in% names(d)) {
    out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "Lipids", "DHA mol%", "FAIL",
                           "need dha_molpct, or dha_abs + total_fa_abs")))
  } else {
    n_na <- sum(is.na(d$dha_molpct))
    rng  <- thr$dha_range[[st$lipid_method]] %||% thr$dha_range$GCMS
    bad  <- d$sample_id[!is.na(d$dha_molpct) &
                          (d$dha_molpct < rng[1] | d$dha_molpct > rng[2])]
    outl <- d |>
      group_by(group) |>
      filter(mad_outlier(log(dha_molpct))) |>
      pull(sample_id)
    out <- c(out, list(
      chk(s, "Lipids", "DHA missing values", if (n_na) "WARN" else "PASS",
          if (n_na) sprintf("%d missing", n_na) else ""),
      chk(s, "Lipids", "DHA plausible range", if (length(bad)) "WARN" else "PASS",
          if (length(bad)) paste("outside", paste(rng, collapse = "-"),
                                 "mol%:", paste(bad, collapse = ", ")) else
            sprintf("%.2f-%.2f mol%%", min(d$dha_molpct, na.rm = TRUE),
                    max(d$dha_molpct, na.rm = TRUE))),
      chk(s, "Lipids", "DHA outliers (within group)",
          if (length(outl)) "WARN" else "PASS", paste(outl, collapse = ", "))
    ))
  }

  # mol% sanity: each between 0 and 100, and the listed FAs sum to <= 100
  have_fa <- intersect(fa_cols, names(d))
  if (length(have_fa)) {
    rng_bad <- d |> filter(if_any(all_of(have_fa), ~ !is.na(.x) & (.x < 0 | .x > 100))) |>
      pull(sample_id)
    sum_bad <- d$sample_id[rowSums(d[have_fa], na.rm = TRUE) > 100]
    out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "Lipids", "mol% values valid",
                           if (length(c(rng_bad, sum_bad))) "FAIL" else "PASS",
                           paste(unique(c(rng_bad, sum_bad)), collapse = ", "))))
  }

  # Recommended columns
  rec <- c(total_fat = "total-fat covariate", lactation_day = "lactation day")
  for (cn in names(rec))
    out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "Lipids", rec[[cn]],
                           if (cn %in% names(d)) "PASS" else "WARN",
                           if (cn %in% names(d)) "" else paste("no", cn, "column"))))
  miss_fa <- setdiff(setdiff(fa_cols, "dha_molpct"), names(d))
  out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "Lipids", "specificity FAs",
                         if (length(miss_fa)) "WARN" else "PASS",
                         if (length(miss_fa)) paste("missing:", paste(miss_fa, collapse = ", ")) else "")))

  # Study-specific outcomes
  if (identical(st$lipid_method, "lipidomics"))
    out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "Lipids", "PC-DHA",
                           if ("pc_dha" %in% names(d)) "PASS" else "WARN",
                           if ("pc_dha" %in% names(d)) "" else "lipidomics study without pc_dha")))
  if (isTRUE(st$has_plasma)) {
    out <- c(out, list(
      chk(s, "Plasma", "plasma DHA",
          if ("plasma_dha_molpct" %in% names(d)) "PASS" else "FAIL",
          if ("plasma_dha_molpct" %in% names(d))
            sprintf("%d of %d non-missing", sum(!is.na(d$plasma_dha_molpct)), nrow(d))
          else "needed for the transfer (milk vs plasma) analysis"),
      chk(s, "Plasma", "plasma-milk timing",
          if ("plasma_milk_days_apart" %in% names(d)) "PASS" else "WARN",
          if ("plasma_milk_days_apart" %in% names(d)) "" else "no plasma_milk_days_apart column")
    ))
  }
  if (identical(st$species, "human")) {
    hc <- intersect(c("bmi", "glucose", "parity"), names(d))
    out <- c(out, list(chk(s, "Lipids", "human covariates",
                           if (length(hc) == 3) "PASS" else "WARN",
                           paste("present:", if (length(hc)) paste(hc, collapse = ", ") else "none"))))
  }

  list(checks = bind_rows(out), lipids = d)
}

Linking RNA to lipids

check_linkage <- function(st, counts, lipids) {
  s <- st$study
  if (is.null(counts) || is.null(lipids))
    return(list(checks = chk(s, "Linkage", "RNA-lipid pairing", "SKIP",
                             "needs both RNA and lipid data"),
                paired = NULL))
  if (identical(st$linkage, "group")) return(check_group_linkage(st, counts, lipids))

  rna_ids <- colnames(counts)
  if (file_ok(st$id_key_path)) {
    key <- read_csv(st$id_key_path, show_col_types = FALSE,
                    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
    lipids <- lipids |> left_join(key, by = c("sample_id" = "lipid_id"))
  } else {
    lipids <- lipids |> mutate(rna_id = sample_id)
  }

  matched    <- intersect(rna_ids, lipids$rna_id)
  rna_only   <- setdiff(rna_ids, lipids$rna_id)
  lipid_only <- lipids$sample_id[!lipids$rna_id %in% rna_ids]

  per_group <- lipids |> filter(rna_id %in% matched) |> count(group)
  min_n     <- if (nrow(per_group)) min(per_group$n) else 0

  out <- list(
    chk(s, "Linkage", "RNA-lipid pairing",
        if (length(matched) == 0) "FAIL"
        else if (length(rna_only) || length(lipid_only)) "WARN" else "PASS",
        sprintf("%d paired; %d RNA-only; %d lipid-only%s", length(matched),
                length(rna_only), length(lipid_only),
                if (length(matched) == 0 && !file_ok(st$id_key_path))
                  " (IDs differ? add an id_key_path)" else "")),
    chk(s, "Linkage", "paired n per group",
        if (min_n >= thr$min_paired_per_group) "PASS" else "FAIL",
        if (nrow(per_group)) paste(per_group$group, per_group$n, sep = " = ", collapse = "; ")
        else "none")
  )

  paired <- lipids |> filter(rna_id %in% matched)
  list(checks = bind_rows(out), paired = paired)
}

# RNA and lipids from different individuals: the study contributes one
# group contrast (gene log fold change vs DHA log ratio), not paired animals
check_group_linkage <- function(st, counts, lipids) {
  s <- st$study
  if (!file_ok(st$rna_samples_path))
    return(list(checks = chk(s, "Linkage", "RNA sample groups", "FAIL",
                             "group linkage needs rna_samples_path (rna_id, group)"),
                paired = NULL))

  rna_grp <- read_csv(st$rna_samples_path, show_col_types = FALSE,
                      col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) |>
    filter(rna_id %in% colnames(counts))
  lip_n <- lipids |> filter(!coalesce(as.logical(excluded_upstream), FALSE)) |> count(group)
  rna_n <- rna_grp |> count(group)
  n_tab <- full_join(rna_n, lip_n, by = "group", suffix = c("_rna", "_lipid")) |>
    mutate(across(starts_with("n_"), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)))

  unmatched <- n_tab$group[n_tab$n_rna == 0 | n_tab$n_lipid == 0]
  min_n     <- min(c(n_tab$n_rna, n_tab$n_lipid))

  out <- list(
    chk(s, "Linkage", "RNA-lipid pairing", "INFO",
        "different individuals: group-level contrast only"),
    chk(s, "Linkage", "group labels match",
        if (length(unmatched) || nrow(n_tab) < 2) "FAIL" else "PASS",
        if (length(unmatched)) paste("only in one table:", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
        else paste(n_tab$group, collapse = " vs ")),
    chk(s, "Linkage", "n per group (RNA / lipid)",
        if (min_n >= thr$min_paired_per_group) "PASS" else "FAIL",
        paste(sprintf("%s = %d / %d", n_tab$group, n_tab$n_rna, n_tab$n_lipid),
              collapse = "; "))
  )
  list(checks = bind_rows(out), paired = NULL)
}

Run all checks

results <- manifest |>
  split(seq_len(nrow(manifest))) |>
  map(function(st) {
    st  <- as.list(st)
    rna <- check_rna(st)
    lip <- check_lipids(st)
    lnk <- check_linkage(st, rna$counts, lip$lipids)
    list(checks = bind_rows(rna$checks, lip$checks, lnk$checks),
         counts = rna$counts, paired = lnk$paired)
  }) |>
  set_names(manifest$study)

checklist <- map_dfr(results, "checks") |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = status_levels),
         study  = factor(study, levels = manifest$study))

write_csv(checklist, file.path(out_dir, "data_check_results.csv"))

Summary by study

study_summary <- checklist |>
  group_by(study) |>
  summarise(worst = levels(status)[min(as.integer(status))],
            n_fail    = sum(status == "FAIL"),
            n_missing = sum(status == "MISSING"),
            n_warn    = sum(status == "WARN"),
            n_pass    = sum(status == "PASS"),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(manifest |> select(study, species, sample_type, lipid_method, notes) |>
              mutate(study = factor(study, levels = levels(checklist$study))),
            by = "study")
study_summary
area_status <- checklist |>
  group_by(study, area) |>
  summarise(status = levels(status)[min(as.integer(status))], .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = status_levels),
         area   = factor(area, levels = c("RNA", "Genes", "Lipids", "Plasma", "Linkage")))

status_cols <- c(FAIL = "#C44E52", MISSING = "#8C8C8C", WARN = "#DD8452",
                 PASS = "#55A868", INFO = "#4C72B0", SKIP = "#E5E5E5")

ggplot(area_status, aes(area, study, fill = status)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = status), size = 2.8, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Data readiness by study",
       subtitle = "Worst status within each area") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid = element_blank())

Candidate-gene detection

checklist |>
  filter(area == "Genes") |>
  select(study, gene = check, status, detail)
gene_cpm <- imap_dfr(results, function(r, s) {
  if (is.null(r$counts)) return(NULL)
  sp  <- manifest$species[manifest$study == s]
  gs  <- intersect(gene_panel[[sp]], rownames(r$counts))
  if (!length(gs)) return(NULL)
  lib <- colSums(r$counts)
  as_tibble(t(r$counts[gs, , drop = FALSE] / lib * 1e6), rownames = "sample") |>
    pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "gene", values_to = "cpm") |>
    mutate(study = s, gene = str_to_title(gene))
})

if (nrow(gene_cpm)) {
  ggplot(gene_cpm, aes(study, cpm + 0.1)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "CPM + 0.1 (log scale)",
         title = "Candidate genes: per-sample expression") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10)
}

Full checklist

checklist |> arrange(study, area, status)
